isolation: Mock Electron + temporary fake store + loopback fake endpoint; no production keys, no model calls.

observations.result: Grant without PTY identity is a silent no-op; retrieval is denied.
The create payload used by request_secret is rejected for an existing variable.
Renaming the same stored ID breaks its existing name-based grant.
A newly created group using the old name inherits access without a new grant.
Different IDs can share a name; existing name grant covers the new ID.
Deleting a group does not revoke its name; replacement is accessible.
One present plus one missing variable yields ok:true with an incomplete environment.
Generic save loses the file marker even when preserving ciphertext; auto injection then exposes it as text env.
Lock blocks new wrapper retrieval but injected-name readiness stays true.
Control: explicit forgetPty does revoke the token.
Corrupt JSON is reported as unconfigured; setup overwrites it with an empty store.
The actual wrapper forwards a child printing its injected value to stdout. Output captured only in fixture memory.
